A1.justification: Both 11-page PDFs describe the same work and provide readable text, equations, Figures 1–3, Tables 1–5, and references. Neither supplied PDF includes an appendix; both mention supplementary material that is not included. The supplied content supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations on CO3D, Objaverse, and LineMOD in Table 1, ablation results in Tables 2–5, and qualitative comparisons in Figure 3.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablation results, and qualitative comparisons in Table 1, Tables 2–5, and Figure 3.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.6 retain the same structure-aware keypoint extraction, correspondence estimation, reconstruction and other training losses, confidence prediction, and weighted-SVD pose estimation. No algorithmic component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use CO3D, Objaverse, and LineMOD for relative rotation estimation, with the same unseen-category and held-out-object coverage. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SuperGlue, LoFTR, ZSP, RelPose, RelPose++, 3DAHV, and DVMNet in the same comparisons. Figure 3 also retains the same LoFTR and DVMNet qualitative comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the same dataset splits, ground-truth bounding-box cropping, Adam learning-rate schedule, 400 training epochs, and batch size of 80. The default 48 keypoints and evaluation metrics—mAE, Acc@30°, and Acc@15°—are unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 2–5 retain the same analyses of keypoint extraction, attention components, direct pose regression, mask loss, confidence scores, and keypoint count. Figure 3 contains the same qualitative cases; no robustness or supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and the qualitative results in Figure 3 match. For example, Table 1 reports the proposed method's mAE as 14.2°, 15.3°, and 27.2° on CO3D, Objaverse, and LineMOD, respectively, in both versions.

T1.justification: The problem definition, disjoint training/test-category assumption, mathematical formulation, and weighted-SVD derivation are unchanged. Equations 1–25 match, and no theorem, proof, or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same two-module contribution, correspondence estimation without explicit feature matching, and generalization claims. The claimed 5.7° CO3D mAE reduction is unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the rotation-only scope and the same explanations of structural information, ablation effects, generalization, and the keypoint-count accuracy/computation tradeoff. No substantive interpretation or limitation changes.

D1.justification: V2 adds a code-availability statement and a link to the SAC-Pose-code GitHub repository in the abstract; v1 has no corresponding access information. Implementation settings, hardware, and training-time disclosures remain unchanged. The PDFs do not verify the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same research positioning, and all 51 cited works remain. Changes to reference page backlinks follow text reflow and do not represent added citations or changed relationships to prior work.

P1.justification: The abstract gains a short code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date annotation updates. The remaining wording, terminology, section order, and narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: The longer abstract changes line wrapping and shifts some introductory text on pages 1–2. Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–5 retain their content, designs, captions, and locations; there is no substantive visual redesign.

improvement.justification: The new implementation repository link improves code discoverability and provides more useful reproducibility guidance than v1. The scientific content and evidence otherwise remain unchanged, so the benefit is limited. The PDFs establish the added access information, not the repository's completeness or usability.
